column1: # mapping_set_description: "LOINC part to Cell Ontology mappings. Parts carrying a '^' qualifier denote a measurement context (timing, specimen order, posture, challenge protocol) applied to the same underlying entity; these are asserted as skos:broadMatch, since the LOINC part is narrower than the ontology concept. Unqualified parts use skos:exactMatch. The predicate revision on qualified parts was applied programmatically; the underlying subject-object mappings are the original manual curation."
